principle: Every important conclusion must be reproducible backward: CONCLUSION -> CLAIM -> RELATIONSHIP -> EVIDENCE -> SOURCE -> ACQUISITION -> TIMESTAMP -> ORIGINAL MATERIAL

TASK_01_BASELINE.finding: Immutable baseline created with git commit, version, schema, 30 DB tables, 344 API paths, 20 documented limitations

TASK_02_EVIDENCE_LIFECYCLE.finding: 8 lifecycle states defined (FOUND→RELEVANT→CORRELATED→CORROBORATED→EVIDENCE→ATTRIBUTED→REJECTED→DISPUTED). DB schema added. 171 evidence items at FOUND status — not yet lifecycle-evaluated.

TASK_03_EVIDENCE_CLAIMS.finding: evidence_claims table created with all required fields. 0 claims generated. Existing evidence uses arbitrary confidence strings.

TASK_04_PROVENANCE.finding: Provenance fields added to evidence table. Some items have source and URL but most lack acquisition method, query reference, and processing history. PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE for most items.

TASK_06_RELATIONSHIP_VALIDATION.finding: entity_links enhanced with relationship_type, source_evidence_id, link_confidence, link_method. Existing 6 links not backfilled with proper types.

TASK_11_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION.finding: All confidence values are arbitrary (0.75-0.9, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). No validation dataset or calibration method. Should use qualitative labels until calibrated.

TASK_12_CONTRADICTION_ENGINE.finding: evidence_contradictions table created. 0 contradictions logged. No existing cases have documented contradictory evidence analysis.

TASK_14_DECISION_AUDIT.finding: investigation_decisions table created with all required fields. 0 structured decisions logged. Existing investigation_steps (12) use different schema.

TASK_21_SECURITY_RED_TEAM.finding: Sub-agent running security tests against GFIN

TASK_23_SMARTSTAR_REINVESTIGATION.finding: 117 SmartStar investigation artifacts exist from 4 passes (001, 002, UK-005, UK-007). Fresh reinvestigation not performed — pipeline not wired as on-demand service.

TASK_24_CONTROLLED_CASES.finding: 10 real cases exist but are reactive, not controlled. Required 6 types: 4 NOT_TESTED, 2 partially covered. Controlled ground-truth cases needed.

TASK_25_POLICE_REPORT_QUALITY.finding: Case summaries exist but lack formal FACT/EVIDENCE/INFERENCE/LEAD/UNRESOLVED labels. Conclusions not traced to evidence IDs.

TASK_26_PERFORMANCE_RESILIENCE.finding: Load test PASSED (200 concurrent, 100%). Most resilience scenarios NOT_TESTED (DB restart, evidence preservation under failure, cross-case contamination).

TASK_27_PRODUCTION_READINESS.finding: 7/14 checks PASS, 5 PARTIAL, 2 FAIL (RLS not enabled, no egress controls). Backup+restore verified, monitoring+alerting active.
